regulation: 민원 처리에 관한 법률 시행규칙 및 각 법령·행정규칙 별지서식 (신청서·청구서·신고서)
description: Structural vocabulary of the 민원·신고 서식 family (HWP usage landscape family ①), as data. check_minwon.py carries no Korean literals: every term and pattern below is family-level — it appears in the 별지서식 convention itself, not in one file. The family's defining property is the INVERSE of 공문's: a 민원 서식's printed guide text (유의사항 / 수수료 / 제출서류 / 동의) is part of the submitted document and must SURVIVE, while a 접수·처리 block belongs to the receiving office and must stay untouched. Term matching is whitespace-insensitive because the 서식 letter-spaces its own labels ('접 수 증', '유 의 사 항', '연 락 처').

furniture.description: The 별지서식's own frame: the statutory header line, the paper-spec footer, and the 귀하 addressee line. All three are printed by the regulation and none of them is a fill target.

staff.description: 접수(처리) 기관 seats — the 민원 처리에 관한 법률 시행규칙 접수란 convention. A citizen filling the form must NOT write here; the receiving office does. Motivated by 정보공개 청구서 (접수번호/접수일/처리기간 + the 접수증 block) and 사업자등록 신청서 (접수번호/처리기간). '접수기관' is deliberately NOT a label: its only corpus appearance is inside the ADDRESSEE line ('(접수 기관의 장) 귀하'), which an agent is supposed to replace with the actual authority — listing it made a correct fill a HARD finding.

select.description: 선택 항목: the [ ] / □ groups. Recognized by glyph, not by label — the option text is per-form, the glyph and the form's own '√표를 합니다' instruction are not.

guide.description: The keep-list. Printed guide blocks that belong to the submitted document: 유의사항, 수수료 안내, 제출서류, 작성방법, 처리절차, and the 동의 blocks (행정정보 공동이용 동의서, 수신동의). Losing one is a defect; this is the family's headline rule.

human.description: Seats a human completes by hand: the 서명 또는 인 parentheticals and the 직인 impression box. The applicant's NAME legitimately shares the cell with the marker ('성명 (서명 또는 인)'), so the rule is that the MARKER survives — not that the cell is unchanged.

identity.description: Identity-number seats. A tool NEVER invents one of these values: 주민등록번호/생년월일/외국인등록번호 are personal data and a fabricated value is worse than an empty seat. Every label here appears in at least one corpus form.

marked_glyph_note: A bracketed slot that now holds SOMETHING is filled. Digits are in the class on purpose: 주민등록 등초본 신청서 uses the same [ ] glyph for a selection ('[ ]등본 사항') and for a small numeric field ('등본 교부 [ ]통'), so '[1]통' has to read as a consumed slot, not as a deleted option. A bare ■ is deliberately NOT a mark — it is the 별지서식 header's own bullet ('■ 주민등록법 시행규칙 [별지 제7호서식]').
shaded_face_brightness_note: Mean-channel brightness of a cell's fillBrush faceColor, 0..1. A cell at or below this value is 'a dark칸'. Measured on the corpus: 정보공개 청구서's staff-only 접수번호/접수일/처리기간 are #B2B2B2 (0.698) and 사업자등록 신청서's 접수번호 row is #BBBBBB (0.733); its section headers are #D8D8D8 (0.847) and #CCCCCC (0.800) — also not fill targets. The lightest tints in the corpus (#F2F2F2 = 0.949, #E0EED1 = 0.877, #EFF6E7 = 0.940) stay above the line. Shading only MEANS staff-only where the form says so (shading_declaration_re); see check_minwon's staff_seats().
identity_seat_note: An identity SEAT is a label, not prose. A cell qualifies only when it carries no checkbox glyph and its squeezed text is at most identity_seat_max_cell_chars long. Measured on the corpus: the real seats are 4–21 squeezed characters ('주민등록번호', '생년월일(성별)()', '여권ㆍ외국인등록번호(외국인의경우작성)'), while 주민등록 등초본 신청서's instruction block mentions 생년월일 inside ~150 characters and carries the [ ] boxes the applicant marks — treating that as a seat made every legitimate checkbox mark look like an identity autofill.
